shortDescription: Exceptionally clean lines meet extraordinary cleaning performance—and it’s also the largest front load washer in its class. The minimalist design is enhanced by an intuitive 7" LCD touchscreen offering elegantly simple operation. Built-in intelligence gets smarter with every use, with AI technology and advanced sensors that detect fabric texture and load size to automatically select the perfect settings. Timesaving features including turbo-charged cleaning and ezDispense® automatic dispenser help you quickly conquer laundry.

features.text: Performance
Built-in Intelligence Takes Out the Guesswork

Forget about endless sorting or toggling through cycles—built-in sensors use AI technology to detect fabric texture and load size, then automatically select the right wash motions, temperatures and more for advanced fabric care.
Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes

With TurboWash® 360°, you can clean larger loads fast and get more done while enjoying the same great washing performance you expect from LG. Five powerful jets with variable sprays surround clothes from multiple angles so detergent can penetrate deep into fabrics for a complete clean—even for big loads—in under 30 minutes.
Clean up to 36 Loads with 1 Easy Fill

No more digging out detergent and fabric softener every time you do laundry—with ezDispense® Automatic Dispenser, just fill the reservoirs once and you’re set for up to 20 to 36 wash cycles with the versatility of using detergent and softener or detergent only. It adds just the right amount for each load size—at just the right time—and will even send an alert to your smartphone when it’s time to refill.
Design
Minimalist Style, Impressive Capacity

With its sleek aesthetic and streamlined design, you may not expect capacity that goes beyond the boundaries of a traditional washer. The massive 5.8 cu. ft. tub accommodates king-size bedding, comforters, oversized towels or washable rugs with ease, all while helping to save time by reducing the number of loads each week. At 29" wide, it’s only slightly larger than standard 27" models but still fits comfortably in most laundry spaces.
Elegantly Simple Operation

Go beyond ordinary buttons and dials with an intuitive 7" LCD touchscreen that simplifies laundry and places total control at your fingertips. The elegant panel perfectly complements the modern, flat front design, luxe brushed steel finish and tinted tempered glass door.
Premium Looks Designed to Last

Real tempered glass door provides a sleek, stylish look that also resists shock and scratches. The dark chrome door trim offers a finished look that nicely contrasts the brushed steel finish and enhances the premium feel.
Smooth Surface Helps Prevent Snags
Unlike tubs made from porcelain or plastic, the LG NeveRust® Stainless Steel Tub avoids the chips and nicks that can snag fabrics and ruin clothing.
Convenience
A smarter Home Starts with the ThinQ® app

The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home. Manage and monitor your washer remotely, track and download cycles, connect with Google or Alexa voice assistants, and access smart diagnosis, customer support, and more. ThinQ Care appliances send usage, maintenance, and diagnostic alerts to help you keep them running smoothly. ThinQ UP appliances receive software updates for new features.
Smart Pairing
With Smart Pairing™, the washer can even tell the dryer to select a compatible drying cycle, making it the ultimate laundry hack.
Wash Two Loads at Once

Wash small loads that just can’t wait while cleaning a larger load in the main washer by adding the ingenious LG SideKick® 29" pedestal washer (Sold Separately). Controlled via the main washer’s touch panel, you can choose from warm and cold settings and 6 cycles to care for delicates, hand washables, workout wear and more. Elevate your possibilities—and elevate your washer for easier loading and unloading.
